svg.title: Create an isolated Firefox practice profile — instructional mockup
svg.desc: Step-specific guided recreation. Not a genuine screenshot or live result.
svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Create an isolated Firefox practice profile
Your Windows host · Firefox profile manager
Finish → Launch profile in new browser
Confirm this is the separate practice profile.
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
A separate Firefox window uses the SONIC TLS Practice profile.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. On Windows, open current Firefox. Type about:profiles in the address bar and press Enter.
2. Click Create a New Profile, then Next. Name it SONIC TLS Practice and click Finish.
3. Find that new profile and click Launch profile in new browser. If it became your default, use Set as
default profile beside your original profile in about:profiles to keep everyday browsing separate.
4. Use only the newly launched SONIC TLS Practice window for the following trust step. Do not install
the practice root in Windows Trusted Root Certification Authorities.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
